origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: Aḥeckil n waman i yesseḥbibiren tiɣawsiwin n waman. D axxam-is deg ugaraw, maca yettenɣay deg iẓuran.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Ḍegger taḥnaccaḍt n waman ɣer sdat, ad d-teḍru 4 n wuguren u ad tbeɛdeḍ iɛdawen. 5 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Serreḥ i yiwet n lemleḥ ara ak-d-yerren 6 HP i kečč akked wid i k-d-yezzin. Ssuma-s 3 mana. 10 n tasinin n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Aman
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: Ɛummet s tɣawla ugar n tannumi.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Rnu-d s ttawil i tezmert-ik mi ara tiliḍ deg waman.
Ḍegger iman-ik deg tneẓrufin d tmazirt  azwu-nni yeqquren yessečča-k lǧehd.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: Ur yeǧhid ara
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Mudd-d s 25% drus n wuguren deg umennuɣ. Tazmert-ik tetteddu s waman, mačči s yiẓuran.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Fire Mage
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Aḥeckul n tmes, yeṭṭerḍeq s tmes, yettruẓu ɣer ǧahennama, yesseṛɣay win i k-iweten. times ur k-tettḍurru, ma d aman ad k-nɣelben.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Fireball
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Ḍegger-d rebεa n tebyilin n tmes d timecṭuḥin ɣer tama i tettwaliḍ. Ssuma-s 3 n tmanatin. 4 n tasinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Serreḥ i tmes i yettḍurrun akk iɛdawen iqerben. Ssuma-s 3 n mana. 8 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Imakaren ttawin-d 30% seg lexṣara i d-wten d tiririt n tmes.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: Ur d-tettḍurru ara tmes, lva, akked yiḥedran n magma. Lva d taḥmayant kan.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Awi 1 n wuguren i tasint mi ara tiliḍ deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Tafurna tagensant
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Laẓ yettawi 50% s tɣawla seg uzɣal yellan sdaxel.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Air Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Aṛumant arurad i d-yettḍeyyiɛen aḍu, i d-yettḍeyyiɛ aḍu n uḥemmal, i d-yettawin ifuyla ɣer yigenni. Fessus am ubeḥri, maca d aweɛṛan am yifer.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Ḍegger-d aḍu ara d-yeǧǧen kra n uḥemmal mi ara d-yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Tazawwa
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Ḍeggeṛ-d aḍu i d-yettawin tazawwa mi ara d-yeɣli  ad d-yejbed, ad d-yerfed, ad d-yezzi ɣef tɣawsiwin i d-yezzin azal n rebɛa n tasinin. Ssuma-s d 4 n mana.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Updraft
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Ḍegger iman-ik ɣer yigenni ɣef tgejdit n uzwu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Aḍu ad k-yesseḥbibir ɣef tuɣalin-ik•im  ulac ayen ara k-yeɣlin mi ara teɣliḍ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Yettawi-ten waḍu n deffir  ttazzalen s 20% ɣef uḍar.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Featherfall
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Sider s ttawil, amzun d awezɣi kan i d-tetteddu tnezɣelt. Sens-itt s tsarut n tzemmar ticki tesriḍ ad tṣubbeḍ s tɣawla.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Akatar afessas
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 n wulawen (-4 HP afellay). Tafekka n uzwu ur tettwabna ara akken ad teqqim.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Fessus
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Rnu 50 n yiseggasen n tuɣalin ɣer deffir  aḍu yettawi-k-id s sshala.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Gravity Mage
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: Aḥeṭṭay n yiberdan n tnezzut i yettheggin amkan s yiman-is. Ssufɣem iɛdawen ɣer yiwet n tmucuha n tmucuha neɣ rẓet-iten. — ma d lǧețța-k ur teqqen ara ɣef lqaɛa.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Aẓru n gravity
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Sseqdec tafergact taberkant ara yeɣlin deg ugrudem aberkan mi ara d-teɣli. Iferdisen iqerben ad ttwaḥerren ɣer tlemmast-is syen ad ttwaḍurren azal n rebɛa n tsinin. Yeswa 4 n mana. 20 n tsinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Serreḥ i yiwet n lemwaji n uḥemmal ara d-yessufɣen akk tiɣawsiwin i d-yezzin. Ssuma-s 3 n tmanatin. 4 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Yettwakkes s umezwer: mgal taẓeyt u rfed ɣef tladna (Levitation I). Yensa s lexṣas  rmed s tsarut n tzemmar.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Rnu 75% n usekḥer  taẓeyt-ik·im taẓeyt tettarra-k·m teshel i usekker.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: D arurad
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Mudd-d s 25% drus n wuguren deg umennuɣ. Tazmert-ik tezga-d deg usekḥer, mačči deg lmektub.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Ameskar aberkan
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: Aḥbib n tili i d-yettnernin tiɣawsiwin n tili i d-yezzin d ubrid gar teḥnacin n tillas. Yettwaḥerrek yerna yettmettat deg yiḍ, maca tafat n yiṭij tesserɣay tazmert-ik.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Sers tafergact n tili deg wadig-ik ara d-yawin tillas akked tderɣalt i yeεdawen iqerben. Ar alamma d 3 n tfergacin i yermed ɣef tikelt. Ssuma-s 3 n mana. 5 n tasinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Azen ɣer wanda tettwaliḍ, alamma d 24 n yiḥedran. Ssuma-s d 2 n wamanat. 4 n tasinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Wali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Imḍebbren ttwalin-k-id seg 40% kan n temnaḍt-nsen tamagnut.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Awi 1 n wuguren i tasint deg tafat n yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Taneɣruft-iw 30% d tarussint  tafat n tjumma yettwabeqqeḍen tettkerric allen-ik.
